key.name: live
key.description: The clock shows what is happening now: music, a timer, a call, a recording, a link from the phone, an update ready. Off, the clock is GNOME's own.

key.name: privacy-dots
key.description: A dot in the top bar while the microphone, the camera, the screen or the location is in use, with a list of which.

key.name: glow
key.description: A thin red glow round every screen while it is recorded or shared. It shows in a recording of the whole screen.

key.name: quiet
key.description: Banners wait in the list while a window is fullscreen on the main screen or the screen is recorded or shared. Urgent ones, calls and alarms still come through.

key.name: quiet-night
key.description: Banners wait in the list between Night Light's times.

key.name: digest
key.description: Banners that are not urgent wait and come together, as one card, at the digest times.

key.name: digest-times
key.description: When the digest comes, as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock, one to six of them. Anything else is ignored.

key.name: digest-through
key.description: Launcher IDs (APP.desktop) whose banners show at once while the digest is on. Quiet, a mute and a focus profile still hold them.

key.name: digest-wait
key.description: Launcher IDs (APP.desktop) whose banners always wait for the next digest time, also while the digest is off. Calls, alarms and urgent banners still pass.

key.name: later
key.description: Later on a banner brings it back in an hour, this evening, tomorrow morning or when the screen is next unlocked; Mute holds an app's banners for an hour. Both are kept in memory only, and listed in the calendar's notifications.

key.name: later-times
key.description: When Later's "This evening" and "Tomorrow morning" come back, as HH:MM on the 24-hour clock, in that order. A missing or bad one takes its default.

key.name: meetings
key.description: Five minutes before an event of today's calendar that carries a video-call link, the pill shows it with a countdown and Join. The link opens only when Join is clicked.

key.name: whats-new
key.description: The first session after an update, the pill says "Updated" for a minute, and a click shows what the update brought and opens the Manual's page for it.

key.name: saving-data
key.summary: Saving data on a connection that counts it
key.description: On a connection NetworkManager calls metered (a phone's hotspot, mobile broadband, or one marked so), the pill says "Saving data", lists what waits for another network and offers Update anyway. It only shows: the waiting is the updaters' own, by the connection's metered flag. ame desktop saving-data and Control write it.

key.name: second-zone
key.summary: A second time zone beside the clock
key.description: A time zone by its name in the system's time-zone data (Asia/Tokyo), whose time is shown after the clock with its city; empty for none.
